page_intro: Check in each prayer, keep your streak, and watch your good deeds grow.
humble_note: Hasanat here are a gentle encouragement, not a judgement. Allah alone knows the true reward of every prayer.
empty_state: Your tracker is waiting for its first prayer. Check in the next one below — every journey begins with a single step.
timezone_note: Your day follows the time zone:
no_mosque_text: Find your mosque on the globe and mark it as your own: its published times will appear here, and prayers at the mosque will be linked to it.
dialog_intro: How did this prayer go? Be honest with yourself — that is what counts.
suggested_hint: Suggested from the current time and the prayer's window.
place_mosque_none: No mosque chosen yet — the check-in is still counted at the mosque.
week_hint: Tap a square to fill in or correct a recent day.
rule_streak: Each prayer, per day of streak (up to {max} days)
rules_phone_note: Stillness and rakaat come only from the companion phone app's sensors. A missed prayer earns no points.
toast_saved: Prayer saved — +{points} hasanat. May Allah accept it.
toast_saved_missed: Noted. There is always the next prayer — may Allah make it easy.
error_future: You cannot log a prayer on a day that has not come yet.
error_too_old: Prayers can be logged or changed for the last {days} days only.
error_not_yet: This prayer's time has not come yet.
api_no_mosque: No mosque chosen yet. Mark a mosque as your own on the website.
api_range_order: The start date must be on or before the end date.
api_range_limit: Ask for {days} days or fewer at a time.
tokens_intro: Connect the Salat Time iPhone or Android app to your account with a personal access token.
tokens_hint: Each token is valid for {days} days. You can have up to {max} tokens.
tokens_new_once: Here is the token for "{name}". Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
tokens_empty_text: Create a token, then paste it into the companion app to sync your prayers.
tokens_revoke_text: The device using this token will be disconnected right away. Your prayer history stays safe.
tokens_limit: You already have {max} tokens. Revoke one before creating another.
tokens_how_text: The companion apps call the API with the token in the Authorization header:
